events.name: Tampa Bay Lightning at Buffalo Sabres

headlines.description: — Jason Zucker tipped in Bowen Byram’s shot for the go-ahead goal 7:38 into the second period, and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 4-2 on Monday night, further tightening the race for the Atlantic Division title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zucker scores go-ahead goal and Sabres beat Lightning 4-2 in showdown of Atlantic Division Leaders

headlines.description: — Kyle Connor scored twice, and Jonathan Toews and Gabriel Vilardi had a goal and an assist each to lead the Winnipeg Jets to a 6-2 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Kyle Connor scores twice and Jets roll past Kraken 6-2

events.name: Chicago Blackhawks at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Will Smith earned his 100th NHL point with a third-period goal, and the San Jose Sharks beat the Chicago Blackhawks 3-2 on Tuesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Will Smith scores to lead Sharks past Blackhawks 3-2

events.name: Nashville Predators at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Adrian Kempe scored the only goal of the shootout in the second round, and the Los Angeles Kings tightened the Western Conference playoff race with a 3-2 win over the Nashville Predators on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Adrian Kempe scores in shootout as Kings beat Predators 3-2
